item.title: 17 Nov 2026: Tech Slides as Chip Export Curbs Pressure Equities
item.description:
The S&P 500 fell 1.01 percent on Tuesday as tightened artificial intelligence chip restrictions and pre-earnings nervousness dragged on technology. Energy and consumer staples offered relative stability while materials and financials led broad declines. Overseas, semiconductor export controls and Middle East energy disruptions remained top geopolitical concerns.

item.title: 13 Nov 2026: Tech Sell-Off Pressures Markets as Nvidia Shifts
